ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 251 Section G is reserved for students in the MCB Honors Concentration. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 22, 2022. MCB 251 laboratory sections will not meet the week of September 5, 2022. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is assessed on and non-refundable after the 10th day of class.
